title: Find my gym on the Gym tab and the Plus lock are listed as live or switchable, but the member paid-plan switch keeps both off
what: The feature list calls 'Find my gym with my number' live and the 7-day Plus lock a gym owner's switch. In the app members get from Google Play the member paid-plan master switch is off, so the Find my gym card on the Gym tab never shows and nothing is ever locked, whatever the gym owner sets. Only the separate 'Continue with your phone number' sign-in on the first screens uses the same number search.
expected: The feature list marks both as off until the member paid plan is switched on, so nobody counts them as working for members today.
fix_line: Mark both features as off until the member paid plan goes live

title: The feature list says sharing workouts with trainers is on by default, but it starts off
what: The feature list says 'Share my workouts with my trainers' is on by default. In the app it starts off and is turned on only when a member joins through the join screen that tells them; members who joined earlier start off. So trainers see nothing, and one-tap 'Ask my trainer for help' is refused, for every member who never turned it on.
expected: The feature list says the trainer sharing starts off and is turned on at the join screen, so the live count of members trainers can see is not overstated.
fix_line: Correct the feature list: trainer sharing starts off
